plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Sangoma Switchvox IP-PBX (enterprise PEN 22736). It reports uptime, CPU utilization and load, memory and swap usage, current calls, and interface traffic.
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Switchvox appliance, calculated as 100 minus UCD-SNMP ssCpuIdle (1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.11.11.0).

metrics.name: device_cpu_load1
metrics.description: System load average reported by Switchvox (load, 1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.3.3.1); the first number in the reported value is used. This is a load average, not a utilization percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Switchvox appliance, calculated as memory used / memory total x 100 (1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.3.1.1 / .3.1.2). The device refreshes these values about every 10 minutes.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Memory used on the Switchvox appliance (1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.3.1.1, reported in KB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Switchvox appliance (1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.3.1.2, reported in KB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_swap_used
metrics.description: Swap space in use on the Switchvox appliance (1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.3.1.3, reported in KB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_swap_total
metrics.description: Total swap space of the Switchvox appliance (1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.3.1.4, reported in KB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: concurrent_calls
metrics.description: Total number of current calls on the Switchvox PBX (1.3.6.1.4.1.22736.10.5.1).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
